title: admesh3D: experimental 3D tetrahedral and prism mesher in the ADMESH family
description:
admesh3D is an experimental Python prototype for three-dimensional meshing in the ADMESH family. It fills a signed-distance-function domain with tetrahedra by the 3D DistMesh method, extrudes a 2D triangle mesh into sigma-layer prisms, reports element quality and writes ASCII VTU files for ParaView. The domain primitives are box, sphere and cylinder with union, intersection and difference. Install with pip install admesh3D; the import name is admesh3d.

This release (0.1.0)

Added

  • First tagged release: tetrahedralize for signed-distance-function domains, extrude for sigma-layer prisms, Mesh.quality_report and Mesh.to_vtu.
  • DistMesh progress callback and denser size-function seeding.

Roadmap at 0.1.0

  • Now: first tagged release of the prototype.
  • Next: API review after first user feedback (no date).
  • Later: one ecosystem with ADMESH, CHILmesh and QuADMESH.
